corpora.label: BDNS subsidy concessions
limitations: This is a bounded 1419-page cohort containing 1360382 of 28676987 official concessions observed on 2026-08-12 across 89 complete date windows; it is not the complete historical registry.

The worker fails closed before claims when storage is below its configured floor; the latest local preflight is blocked with 5685862400 bytes free against 10863247360 required and -5177384960 bytes of headroom.

A checksum-verified content-addressed Hugging Face release carries the stable artifact contract and provides a durable public origin; a disposable isolated restore of all 20 selected files passed full validation of 1360382 rows with bounded memory.

corpora.label: Cross-source accountability ledger
limitations: The clean 2026-08-12 materialization contains 126760 rows from boe_api_legal, congreso_votaciones, and senado_votaciones; ten fixture-derived PLACSP/BDNS rows and their downstream issues and ledger entries were removed.
The corpus is dominated by parliamentary actions and is not representative of money, implementation, enforcement, audits, or outcomes.

corpora.next_gate: Expand the ledger with representative rules, appointments, money, implementation, enforcement, audit, and outcome facts; reach one million real rows.
